dockerStartCmd:
_fvr2_id="${FV_WEIGHTS_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" _fvr2_secret="${FV_WEIGHTS_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}"; unset FV_WEIGHTS_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID FV_WEIGHTS_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
( used=0; n=0; tx0=0
  fv_self_delete() {
    # GraphQL podTerminate: the pod-scoped key may not DELETE through REST (HTTP 403,
    # docs/adr/0023-lab-report-and-ci-bridge.md §4). Success: HTTP 200 and no "errors".
    # The key reaches curl on stdin (-H @-), never in its argv; the answer is logged, then removed.
    _fvsd_code=$(printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$RUNPOD_API_KEY" | curl -sS --max-time 30 -o "$1.resp" \
      -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://api.runpod.io/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H @- \
      --data "{\"query\":\"mutation { podTerminate(input: {podId: \\\"$RUNPOD_POD_ID\\\"}) }\"}" 2>>"$1")
    { cat "$1.resp"; echo " http=$_fvsd_code"; } >>"$1" 2>/dev/null
    _fvsd_ok=1
    [ "$_fvsd_code" = 200 ] && ! grep -q '"errors"' "$1.resp" 2>/dev/null && _fvsd_ok=0
    rm -f "$1.resp"
    return "$_fvsd_ok"
  }
  txb() { awk 'NR > 2 { sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); split($0, f, /[: ]+/); if (f[1] != "lo") s += f[10] } END { printf "%.0f", s }' /proc/net/dev 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
  [ "net" = net ] && tx0=$(txb)
  while sleep 60; do
    u=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1 | tr -d ' ')
    sent=0
    if [ "net" = net ]; then tx1=$(txb); sent=$(( tx1 - tx0 )); tx0=$tx1; fi
    if [ "${u:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || [ "$sent" -ge 262144 ] 2>/dev/null; then used=1; n=0; else n=$((n + 1)); fi
    lim=30; [ "$used" = 1 ] && lim=10
    if [ "$n" -ge "$lim" ] && [ -n "${RUNPOD_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -n "${RUNPOD_POD_ID:-}" ]; then
      echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) idle $n min at 0 % GPU: deleting pod $RUNPOD_POD_ID" >>/tmp/idle-watchdog.log
      fv_self_delete /tmp/idle-watchdog.log
    fi
  done ) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
set -u
OUT=/root/runs/upstream/1234567-10241200
mkdir -p "$OUT"
# What oracle.sh fetches as its heartbeat while the runtime pod is up.
head -c 1048576 /dev/urandom >/root/runs/keepalive.bin 2>/dev/null || true
if fv-gpucheck serve --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ( while true; do fv-gpucheck serve --dir /root/runs --port 8000; sleep 2; done ) >/tmp/http.log 2>&1 &
else
  ( cd /root/runs && while true; do python3 -m http.server 8000; sleep 2; done ) >/tmp/http.log 2>&1 &
fi
# The runner scripts come from this repo at $UP_SHA (so a script fix needs no
# image rebuild); baked images keep a copy in /opt/fvrs as the fallback.
RUNNER=/opt/fvrs
{
  command -v git >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git; }
  git init -q /opt/fvrs-live && git -C /opt/fvrs-live remote add origin https://github.com/zaitrarrio/fastvideo-rs.git     && git -C /opt/fvrs-live fetch -q --depth 1 origin 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678 && git -C /opt/fvrs-live checkout -q FETCH_HEAD     && echo live
} >"$OUT/clone.log" 2>&1 && RUNNER=/opt/fvrs-live
FV_WEIGHTS_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$_fvr2_id" FV_WEIGHTS_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$_fvr2_secret" env FASTVIDEO_DUMP_OPS=0,1,24,47 UP_STEPS="info:box r2:sfwan21-1.3b oracle:sfwan13" UP_STEPS_BG="" UP_CELLS=""   UP_CELL_TIMEOUT_S=7200 UP_LOCAL=1   bash $RUNNER/scripts/gpu/upstream/pod.sh "$OUT" >"$OUT/pod.out" 2>&1
echo "done 1234567-10241200" >"$OUT/DONE"
exec sleep infinity
gpuTypeIds: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
name: fv-lab-upstream-1234567-10241200
